issue: The workbench stopped GET polling only for terminal states. Confirmed paused and waiting_user records were repeatedly fetched every four seconds, including hidden historical tasks.
change: Confirmed paused/waiting_user records become idle for background polling. Manual refresh, selecting their task or returning focus/visibility rechecks them. queued/running/stopping records remain polled, with the existing concurrency and stale-action guards.
uncertainActions: An explicit action clears the idle guard. If its response is unconfirmed, only GET recovery restarts; the action is never automatically resubmitted.

isolatedBrowser.network: Closed local API fixture; external and unrecognized requests rejected
newAssertions: No repeated paused GET across two real four-second polling periods
Focus triggers exactly one read and idle resumes

liveObservation.boundary: Uncontrolled-client observation only; not a measured speed improvement or independent performance benchmark.

qualityBoundary: These checks verify interaction and request lifetime, not model answer quality or independent holdout acceptance.
